description:
You are a GP working with MedinTux. Log in by clicking any practitioner name. Three patients require medical correspondence documents today:

1. ROUX Celine (born 1977-08-11): This patient has type 2 diabetes with recent HbA1c of 9.2% (poorly controlled) and retinopathy screening overdue. She needs a referral letter (courrier medical) to an endocrinologist at the nearest hospital. Include the reason for referral and relevant clinical context.

2. FOURNIER Jacques (born 1950-03-08): This patient had a work accident (chute avec entorse de cheville droite, arret de travail depuis le 2026-01-15) and the injury is now consolidated — he is able to return to work. Create a medical certificate (certificat medical) confirming the consolidation date of 2026-03-01 and fitness for return to work.

3. GAUTHIER Helene (born 1974-06-18): This patient reports new-onset palpitations (2-3 episodes per week over the past month, lasting 5-10 minutes) and has documented hypertension and a family history of cardiac arrhythmia. She needs a referral letter (courrier medical) to a cardiologist requesting a Holter ECG and specialist evaluation.

For each patient, open their file and create the appropriate document in MedinTux. The documents must be attached to the correct patient file — wrong-patient documents will not count.
